about: Water names in the San Diego Water Board's table of USIBWC spill and transboundary flow events (source ca-sd-regional-board-ibwc-spills), the Tijuana River valley: one row per name with its number of table rows and the towns (no point: the table gives none). Kept apart from receiving-waters-missing.json so a --names run on it asks these names only and builds only the hand records that name this file (ingest/waters_from_nhd.py hand_scope). The proposals and their sources are in tijuana-water-records-proposed.json.
